---
title: "Spike B: hard cases"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
source("common.R")
source("rowmask.R")

group   <- "cars"
cols    <- c("mpg", "cyl", "disp", "hp", "wt", "gear", "am")
filters <- list(cyl = list(input = "radio", label = "Cylinders"))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::tagList(
  spike_dep("qr-spike-rowmask", "rowmask.js"),
  spike_filters(mtcars, group, rownames(mtcars), filters)
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
mask_plotly(plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~mpg, type = "histogram"), group)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
mask_ggplotly(ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, hp, colour = factor(cyl))) + geom_point(), group)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
mask_dt(datatable(mtcars[mtcars$mpg > 20, cols]), group)
```
